title: UFOs could hide in oceans, admiral says, as 'alien base' claim emerges
excerpt: UFOs could be using our oceans to remain hidden from humanity, a retired US admiral has suggested, as a huge underwater feature has been touted as a possible entrance to one such secret hideout.
content:
Humanity has yet to make contact with aliens, and a retired US Navy Admiral has proposed a radical reason why: they are hiding in our oceans.

Tim Gallaudet, a former acting administrator of the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA), recently explained why Earth's deep ocean may be the perfect hiding spot.

Speaking on the Hang Out with Sean Hannity podcast, Gallaudet said: 'If they were to go somewhere basically to not be detected for a period of time... where would you want to go?

'You'd want to go... [to] the most unexplored area of the world, and that's the ocean.' 

After decades of studying the ocean, Gallaudet believes its largely uncharted depths could conceal phenomena that have so far escaped detection. 

'We've only explored with either drones, buoys [or] floats, about 10 percent of ocean volume,' Gallaudet said. 'So there's a lot of mystery out there right now.' 

His comments come as a UFO researcher claims to have found an entrance into an underwater alien base off the coast of Canada.

Scott C Waring uncovered a mysterious hole in the waters surrounding Nunavut, which he claimed was more than 3,000 feet across and about 32 feet below the surface.

A retired US Navy admiral claimed that UFOs could be hiding under Earth's ocean amid a claim that an alien base has been identified in waters off the coast of Canada

During the interview, Gallaudet highlighted a video he claimed showed mysterious objects moving underwater before jumping out to the surface.

'It goes into the ocean, no disturbance,' Gallaudet told Sean Hannity during the podcast. 

'I'm aware of another video that shows something similar, but from overhead... so yeah, there's something that they've been able to engineer that we have no idea how to reproduce,' he added. 

Gallaudet claimed the objects could break the sound barrier without the thunderous boom that normally accompanies supersonic flight, a feat he said defies explanation with current technology. 

He testified under oath before Congress in 2024, claiming there was a 2015 incident involving near-midair collisions with UFOs during a carrier strike group exercise and the subsequent disappearance of an urgent email report about the event.

The former admiral also asserted that Earth is visited by non-human intelligence utilizing advanced technology with extraordinary flight and transmedium capabilities. 

While Gallaudet has never provided locations where UFO bases could be hiding, Waring believes he has found the entrance to one. 

'I found an entrance to an underwater alien base, and it's in the most remote area of northern Canada that one could go,' Waring posted on his site UFO Sightings Daily.

Tim Gallaudet, a former acting administrator of the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA), recently explained why Earth's deep ocean may be the perfect hiding spot.

'It's a huge tunnel for aliens to enter and exit, totally unseen in such a remote area.'

A remotely operated or autonomous underwater drone could explore the suspected tunnel and record any signs of alien life, Waring suggested. 

The proposed mission could last several days before the craft returned with its footage.

Such technology, he argued, could reach depths too dangerous for humans to explore in person. 

Waring said the venture could even open a direct line of communication between the public and extraterrestrials.

Similar claims about underwater UFOs have been presented by David Grusch, a former intelligence officer who now assists lawmakers with UFO transparency.

Grusch also testified under oath in 2023 that the US government possesses multi-decade secret programs recovering and reverse-engineering crashed non-human spacecraft.

Earlier this month, he told Joe Rogan that officials are aware of at least one giant underwater facility used by extraterrestrials as a 'base of operations' for their craft.

'I'm going to be careful because it gets into sensitive Navy underwater things,' Grusch said.

'There's clearly some sort of base of operations in certain locations. It's large. Don't know when it got there... Like multiple city-block-type stuff.'

He added that 'stuff comes and goes' from the base.

Grusch also claimed that his information came from files on top-secret programs, videos and confessions from government and military insiders.

However, the US military and the White House have maintained for decades that no physical evidence has been found that proves UFOs and alien life exist.
